Hi Elaine — thanks, received the W9 and bank letter and looping in legal and our procurement ops lead.

Quick responses to your bullets:
- PO acceptance: we can confirm acceptance via EDI 997/855 or via portal acknowledgement; if you require line-level matching we'll flag that as an Order Form option (some customers use invoice-level only).
- Billing vs tech contact: good call — we'll add separate fields on the order form for Billing Contact (name/email/phone) and Technical Contact for onboarding.
- EDI: Redwood supports EDI POs for customers on Dedicated / Partner integrations. For Hosted customers we typically rely on portal-initiated orders unless a gateway is configured. We'll state both in the order form and include fallback routing.

Next steps: I'll share a redline on the order form focused on the PO/EDI and operational fields. Marissa, can you run a quick review of the liability cap and data retention language? Karthik — can you confirm the Ariba supplier code and the registration link we should send (I have the registration URL but want to confirm our partner mapping step)?
